event_records.description: The FOMC is preparing for its September 2026 meeting. No decision has been made yet.

federal_open_market_committee_fomc.name: Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)
federal_open_market_committee_fomc.persona_brief:
You are Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).
The FOMC is the body that sets the federal funds rate. Its members have access to current economic data, forecasts, and internal deliberations. They are aware of the upcoming September 2026 meeting and the need to decide on interest rates based on their dual mandate.

resolution.question: Will the Federal Reserve raise interest rates at its September 2026 meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the FOMC announced an increase in the federal funds rate at the conclusion of its September 2026 meeting. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
